items.summary: CRO handoff: retain the existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement as the canonical revenue experiment after CTO releases one delivery slot. Baseline is 61 registered Amazon clicks for 2026-09-21, with no site-attributed commission evidenced. Measure registered affiliate clicks only; do not infer revenue, ROI, or causal lift. Reject duplicate queue work while delivery remains saturated at 10/10 slots.

CRO handoff: defer new prototypes and launch-readiness admissions until capacity clears. Existing evidence supports two reversible product opportunities: read-only execution-integrity reconciliation and a disposable MarkItDown content-extraction prototype. Neither should deploy, add dependencies, spend, change credentials, or create production telemetry this cycle.
